name: RRB Group D
liveCaptureNotes: Candidates are not required to upload a pre-existing photograph.
Live photograph is captured by the application portal using a webcam or the front camera of a mobile phone.
Wear non-white clothing, preferably dark colours, to maintain contrast with the background.
Position the camera at eye level.
Look straight ahead with a neutral expression.
Ensure the entire face is clearly visible and centered within the frame.
Keep your face neither too close nor too far from the camera.
Do not wear a cap, mask, or glasses/spectacles.
Do not capture a printed or digital pre-existing photograph.

notes: Scan using a minimum resolution of 100 DPI.
Signature must be written by the candidate only.
Signature must be in running handwriting (cursive/joined letters), not block, capital, or disjointed letters.
Position the signature within the designated 35 mm × 20 mm scan box.
Center the signature within the scan box.
